decisions.reason: This glazed industrial sectional door belongs to the firm's core industrial door range and to its announced direction of continuous product development, so management will justify it and stay committed even though the evidence since 2019 is thin.

The insulated glazed variant fits the firm's thermal-solution positioning and draws on shared manufacturing investment, so management is likely to blame weak results on temporary causes such as the pandemic and keep it.
Giving this product a dedicated web page signals strong public commitment and centrality to the industrial door line, which makes dropping it the least likely of the three.
